name: Slime Jelly
description: Cool, wobbling jelly scraped from a slime. Alchemists boil it into the base of healing draughts.

name: Gel Core
description: The firm heart of a slime, no bigger than a plum. It keeps its shape for years and sells for pocket change.

name: F-Rank Monster Core
description: A pebble-sized core that stays warm after a monster falls. The first thing every Guild rookie learns to collect; crafters use it to bind a gear's first spark.

name: E-Rank Monster Core
description: A core the size of a thumb, humming faintly. Strong enough to finish E-rank gear and to brew proper healing potions.

name: D-Rank Monster Core
description: A dense, glassy core with a steady pulse. Alchemists pay well for it, and D-rank recipes ask for one.

name: C-Rank Monster Core
description: A bright core that is warm to the touch for a full day. Needed to forge C-rank gear that holds an edge or a ward.

name: B-Rank Monster Core
description: A core the size of a fist, heavy with stored power. B-rank masterwork recipes call for one, and so do some quiet Guild commissions.

name: Relic Shard
description: A sliver of worked stone from a ruin older than the Guild. Scholars would like to know where you found it.

name: S-Rank Monster Core
description: An S-rank core, cold and impossibly dense. Kept in lead-lined cases; the Guild logs every one that changes hands.

name: SSS-Rank Monster Core
description: An SSS-rank core. Even held in a closed fist, the room goes quiet. Reserved for work of national consequence.

name: EX-Rank Monster Core
description: An EX-rank core, older than any record of it. No price is posted; the Guild only says that it exists.

name: Goblin Ear
description: A notched goblin ear, the Guild's proof of a cleared warren. Small bounty, big stack.

name: Crude Blade
description: A goblin-made blade blank, pitted and bent. A smith can re-edge it into something honest.

name: Stolen Trinket
description: A bit of shiny junk a goblin lifted from a traveller. Some owners will pay to get theirs back.

name: A-Rank Monster Core
description: A rare A-rank core that glows when you hold it near a heartbeat. Shops buy it, but few shops can afford to stock it.

name: Kobold Fang
description: A short, yellowed kobold fang. Strung on cord it makes a decent luck charm.

name: Scrap Metal
description: Bent nails, snapped blades and cracked buckles. Torvald calls it the cheapest honest iron in town.

name: Candle Stub
description: A guttering candle end from a monster's nest. Wax and wick, with a bit of old light left in it.

name: Pelt
description: A rough, serviceable animal pelt. The tannery turns it into caps, jerkins and hilt wrap.

name: Fang
description: A clean white fang from a wolf or boar. Smiths set it into blades; hunters wear it for luck.

name: Prime Meat
description: A good cut of fresh monster meat. Cook it the same day and it feeds a table.

name: Cursed Fur
description: Dark fur that seems to hold onto the shadows. It needs shade essence to calm it before it can be worn.

name: Silver-Bane Claw
description: A grey claw that dulls ordinary steel. Alloyed into a blade, it bites back at beasts that shrug off normal edges.

name: Carapace Shard
description: A curved plate of beetle shell, light and tough. Riveted to leather it turns a fair blow.

name: Silk
description: Fine spider silk, strong as thread and soft as a scarf. Weavers use it for hoods, robes and scrolls.

name: Venom Sac
description: A sealed sac of pale venom. Handle it carefully; alchemists distil it into coatings and antidotes.

name: Killer Mandible
description: A serrated mandible from a hunting insect. Sharp enough to cut the cord it hangs from.

name: Stinger
description: A hollow stinger still crackling with trapped charge. Scroll-makers draw storm ink from it.

name: Bone Dust
description: Fine grey dust from a restless skeleton. It is only dust, whatever the stories say.

name: Grave Cloth
description: A shred of shroud that has outlasted its owner. Weavers say it takes dye strangely.

name: Soul Ember
description: A faint orange spark that burns without fuel. It lights a rune of heat.

name: Shade Essence
description: A cold wisp bottled from a shade. A little calms cursed fur; a lot makes the bottle sweat.

name: Night Shard
description: A fragment of black glass that only gleams after dark. Woven into cloth, it softens the evening.

name: Tusk
description: A heavy curved tusk, yellow at the root. Good for hilts, mace heads and amulets.

name: Giant's Hide
description: A slab of thick, stone-scraped hide. The tannery calls it stubborn and soles it into boots.

name: Crude Iron
description: Lumpy smelted iron, still full of grit. Torvald can work it into plain, dependable gear.

name: Horn
description: A ridged horn, hard as a pot handle. Carvers and smiths both buy it.

name: Labyrinth Bronze
description: Old bronze pulled from the Labyrinth walls, green at the edges. Beaten thin it becomes surprisingly light armour.

name: Scale
description: A palm-sized lizard scale, glossy and overlapping. Armourers stitch them in rows.

name: Reptile Eye
description: A yellow, slit-pupilled eye kept in brine. Alchemists swear by it for night sight.

name: Tail Meat
description: Lean meat from a lizard's tail. Slow-roasted, it is the best thing in a long road's menu.

name: Dragon Scale
description: A small scale from a drake, warm to the touch. Hard enough to crack a chisel.

name: Dragon Blood
description: A vial of thick, warm drake blood. It never quite cools, and alchemists treat it with respect.

name: Dragon Heart
description: The heart of a young drake, still faintly beating in its salt jar. Rare, valuable and not for the squeamish.

name: Golem Core
description: A smooth stone heart etched with tiny grooves. It holds the pattern that once made a golem walk.

name: Rune Plate
description: A blank slab of rune-carving stone. Khazdur masons cut every glyph onto one.

name: Gear
description: A hand-turned brass gear from an automaton. Runesmiths use it to anchor the Anvil Rune.

name: Elemental Essence
description: A drop of raw elemental force held in glass. It never stays one temperature for long.

name: Spirit Mote
description: A drifting speck of spirit-light. Catch one in a jar and it lights your desk for a week.

name: Sap
description: Sticky, sweet tree sap. Cooks, alchemists and bomb-makers all keep a jar.

name: Seed
description: A handful of wild seeds. Plant them, grind them, or put them in the stew.

name: Spore Cap
description: A mushroom cap that glows a little in the dark. Safe to eat once roasted.

name: Demon Core
description: A black core with an ember at its centre. It feels angry for no reason; do not carry it near the bread.

name: Horn Shard
description: A chip broken from a demon's horn. Warm to hold, and it smells faintly of struck flint.

name: Brimstone
description: A yellow lump of fire-stone from deep rock. A pinch warms a drink; a handful warms a fortress.

name: SS-Rank Monster Core
description: An SS-rank core. Light bends faintly around it. Legend says each one is the last echo of something that should not have fallen.

name: Fish Scale
description: A silver scale that catches the light like coin. Used in Tide Runes for their cool edge.

name: Pearl
description: A small, round pearl from river or pond. Jewellers set it in bands and charms.

name: Ink Sac
description: A full ink sac, blue-black and slow to dry. Scribes and scroll-makers always need more.

name: Feather
description: A long, glossy flight feather. Light as breath; used for charms and wind-touched scrolls.

name: Talon
description: A hooked bird talon, sharp at the tip. Bound into charms for luck in the hunt.

name: Egg
description: A speckled monster egg, warm and heavy. Bakers prize them.

name: Chimera Heart
description: A three-chambered heart that still beats slowly. Alchemists and masters of the forge both want it.

name: Mythic Horn
description: A single spiral horn, light as a reed and strong as steel. Its owner is long gone; its worth is not.

name: Serpent Scale
description: A broad, patterned scale from a giant serpent. It flexes with the wearer and shrugs off cuts.

name: Temple Gold
description: Soft, pale gold taken from an old shrine. It carries a faint memory of bells.

name: Horsehair
description: Long, coarse hair from a spectral horse. Strong enough to pad armour or string a bow.

name: Painted Barding
description: A piece of ghost-cavalry barding, its paint still bright. Collectors pay more than armourers do.

name: Rider's Lantern
description: A tiny lantern from a ghost rider's saddle. It still burns, though nothing is inside.

name: Cursed Iron
description: Black iron that hums when the lights go out. Smiths work it with respect and leather gloves.

name: Stolen Bolt
description: A crossbow bolt a thief has been saving. Not for you, but you may as well have it.

name: Gremlin Ear
description: A small, pointed ear, Guild proof of a cleared gremlin nest.

name: Unreal Fragment
description: A sliver of something that was not quite there. It flickers when you look away.

name: Eye of Nothing
description: A glassy sphere that reflects nothing at all. Scholars keep it in a drawer and do not discuss it.

name: Spirit Paper
description: A sheet of thin paper cut with prayer marks. Tucked into a hem it is said to turn bad luck aside.

name: Fox Fire
description: A flicker of cool blue flame that never burns. It follows you home if you let it.

name: Dungeon Core Shard
description: A chip from the heart of a dungeon. It hums when you walk near a dungeon door.

name: Vesper Glass
description: Dusk-coloured glass that holds the last light of evening. Prized by lamp-makers and a few tired poets.

name: Captured Soul-Light
description: A small blue light in a glass bead. It brightens near those who are grieving, and nobody knows why.

name: Desert Glass
description: Glass formed where lightning hit the dunes. Pale green and sharper than it looks.

name: Sand Pearl
description: A pearl made in the sand, not the sea. Warm in the hand and strangely heavy.

name: Coin Purse
description: A small, worn purse with a few coppers left in the seam. Return it to its owner if you can.

name: Weapon
description: A battered weapon taken from a defeated foe. Not worth wielding, but the scrap is good.

name: Bounty Proof
description: A scrap of badge or cloth that proves a bounty. Take it to the Guild board.

name: Soft Fur
description: Soft, fine fur from a gentle beast. Tailors line cloaks with it.

name: Shed Scale
description: A scale naturally shed during a moult. Thin, light and good for charms.
